spans.s:
अष्ठि अष्ठि, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 1. अश्? connected
with अशन् and अश्मन्), seed; a kernel, a stone.

अष्ठीला, f. a globular body; a round pebble or
stone; kernel; seed-corn; a globular swelling below
the navel, produced by wind; contusion.
अष्ठीलिका, f. a kind of abscess; a pebble.

अष्ठी-वत्, वान्, वत्, m. n. the knee, knee-bone;
(by native grammarians derived fr. अस्थि.)
आष्ठा आष्ठा, f. [cf. 2. आशा], region, quarter.
